memory_candidates.content: generate-context-line-counts.sh and deploy-headless.sh both refuse to run as the agent-system source-store copy: they must bootstrap from an already-deployed scripts/ tree (.claude/scripts/ or .opencode/scripts/), erroring with an explicit message if run from agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ directly ('../..' resolves to a bogus repo root there). When a plan names the source-store path for either script, run the deployed .claude/scripts/ copy instead -- same effective action, since both regenerate/validate the source-store content either way.
